name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-multilingual-story-card
title: CosmoPolite - multilingual story card
shortDescription: Ask in any language or dialect and get a story card in that language: labels, reading direction, fonts, photo credit and a read-aloud voice all follow the story, including right-to-left scripts.
longDescription: CosmoPolite is a Copilot UX Component, packaged with a declarative agent, that answers in the language you ask in. The agent detects the language of every message, dialects included, and the card shows a short story written in that language with a photo from open collections (Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Openverse, The Met, NASA) and its credit.

Everything on the card follows the story's language: UI labels in 58 languages, lang and dir on every part and on the frame's html element, right-to-left layout for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu, a Nastaliq font for Urdu, and read-aloud with a matching Web Speech voice and word highlighting.

Users can switch between five designs, three photo layouts and light or dark, open the card fullscreen, and translate the story, after which the agent continues and suggests follow-ups in the new language. The component uses no framework and no Microsoft Graph permissions.
